name: Order Confirmation
subject: Order confirmed — {{order.number}}
previewText: Thank you for your order. Tracking info inside.
description: Professional order confirmation with order summary, itemized list, totals, and tracking CTA.
useCase: Send immediately after customer completes purchase. Confirms order details, provides order number and tracking information, reassures customer about next steps.
customizationGuide: Update the items loop to include actual products. Customize the delivery message based on your shipping times. Modify colors to match your brand. Include real order totals.
conversionStrategy: Success badge builds trust. Clear order summary prevents confusion. Prominent tracking button drives engagement. Info box reassures customers about what to expect next.
